candidates.name: Google Muskogee County campuses near Summit and Council Hill
candidates.findings: Primary November 2025 announcement identifies two distinct campuses, near Summit and Council Hill. The April 30 Google construction article is stale; the August 19 Clydesdale article's regional statement does not independently resolve which Muskogee campus or active phase. Port Muskogee identifies Google Project Scissortail and its 419-acre tax-incentive district in its John T. Griffin Industrial Park timeline, but that undated page is not fresh construction evidence. Nearby Core Scientific/Polaris and its Q2 2026 completed first phase must not be conflated with Google.
